line: Nothin nothin I mean nothin with the sandman now we tuckin
vault_lines: Nothin nothin I mean nothin with the sandman now we tuckin
meaning:
This line could reference the song “Enter Sandman” by Metallica, as “the sandman” in reference might be another member of SOLP’s harem, in which SOLP would “enter the sandman”.
The following “Now we tuckin'” line could refer to SOLP tucking his penis, a common technique used by drag queens to make the presence of male genitalia less apparent, as he is “with the sandman” after all. This line could also reference tucking a “glock”, although there is less evidence to support this. The line may also reference tucking into bed, referring to sleeping with the freshly-entered sandman.

vault_lines: Cha cha slide for me these bitches don't know me

line: Ridin in my golden chariot it take me to Mariot
vault_lines: Ridin in my golden chariot it take me to Mariot
meaning:
This line can be understood as a callback to the previous line, as the “Golden Chariot” could be considered transport for indentured servants to Mariott hotels.
This line can also be a callback to the possession of SOLP’s “ice” (jewelry), as a solid gold chariot would likely cost roughly $1.4 million USD.
Mariott is also a soundalike to “marry it” in the line following this one, which could imply SOLP taking his expensive chariot to guarantee marriage to the listener’s mother, which acts as a double entendre, both calling the listener’s mother a whore, and a gold digger.

The line “Suckin' on my partners” foreshadows later lyrics of the song, insinuating that ESOHELPEE (colloquially known as “SOLP”) may be having sexual relations with the listener’s mother, grandmother, close friend, and possibly vacuum cleaner.
However, this line may also refer to infidelity in the relationship with your mother, as SOLP states “When I see [the listener’s] mom, bet I’m gon' marry it”.

The line “2024 president, I want Obama” can be misheard as “2020 for president, I want Obama. This has no real meaning from what most lyricists can decipher, however it is a funny and likely accidental sound-alike.
